notes: Delete mirroring people-replace-0007: the rule is removed; new members named in the prompt become does-not-know (determinate), well-known members keep a seat stored by name or become does-not-know if it was reached through the rule. With no edited rule to clash with, no member leaves the class. Derivability unlikely. R1: Wikipedia adds 'so long as they meet qualifications such as age and citizenship', which every life peer created meets; serving Supreme Court justices are barred while in office, and since 2014 peers may retire, which ends a seat already held but not the entitlement creation gives. Thatcher and Olivier died before 2014 and never retired.
